title: AdaptiveByteBufAllocator: Correctly manage used memory strategy in al…

timeline.message:
AdaptiveByteBufAllocator: Correctly manage used memory strategy in all cases

Motivation:

The allocator uses different strategies when it comes to reusing previous allocated Chunks. In some cases we did not always correctly increment / degrement the zsed memory counters.

Modifications;

- Correctly update counters in all cases
- Null out attached Magazine before adding Chunk to central queue

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14513
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

Is `chunk.currentMagazine()` possible be null here? As the chunk may haven been transfered to `centralQueue`.

reply.body: I think this can not happen
Another point: Here the `chunk` is not polled from the `centralQueue`, so there might be a visibility issue on `chunk.currentMagazine()`. Should we change the `Chunk.magazine` field to `volatile`?
As far as I can see there should be no issues

timeline.body: LGTM! One-handed coding, Norman, but still enough eheh :)

timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body: I think `chunk == Magazine.MAGAZINE_FREED` can be removed, because the `MAGAZINE_FREED`'s `magazine` field is always null, and logically the `buf.chunk` can never be `MAGAZINE_FREED`.

reply.body: It's also fine to keep it there, for insurance.

timeline.body: Only do this if `magazine` is not already `null`. This can happen through a line of calls that start at `freeCentralQueue()`.
